title: An invitation cue ends at first tap
statement: Stop a cue inviting a first tap once the student has tapped that surface, and never restart it after a miss, where it reads as 'tap me again'.
detail: A review of a Grade 3 reading course saw wrong clues blink again after a child tapped them and tapped outside, which read as an invitation to tap them again. The ruling makes the pulse an attract cue for before first engagement only: it switches off on each surface after the child's first tap there and never restarts on a miss or a change of state. A beat that arrives later on the same passage still gets its own one-time invitation on its own surface.
